import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths as given
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_9.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_10.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/test_11.csv"
    ]

    # Target schema columns and their types
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Data types for enforcing target schema
    dtype_map = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    }

    # Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target columns (all sources have same schema)
        # If any extra columns exist, drop them; if missing columns, raise error
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Enforce data types:
        # For integer columns that may have missing values, use pandas nullable Int64 dtype
        # For string columns, convert to string dtype
        # For float columns, convert to float64
        for col in target_columns:
            if dtype_map[col] == 'string':
                # Convert to string, preserving NaNs as <NA>
                df[col] = df[col].astype('string')
            elif dtype_map[col] == 'Int64':
                # Nullable integer type
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
            elif dtype_map[col] == 'int64':
                # Non-nullable integer, convert and fill NaNs with 0 (if any)
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype('int64')
            elif dtype_map[col] == 'float64':
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype('float64')

        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have exactly the same schema as the target,
    # we can concatenate (union) all dataframes vertically
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Final check: ensure columns order and types again (redundant but safe)
    target_df = target_df[target_columns]
    for col in target_columns:
        if dtype_map[col] == 'string':
            target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype('string')
        elif dtype_map[col] == 'Int64':
            target_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(target_df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        elif dtype_map[col] == 'int64':
            target_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(target_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype('int64')
        elif dtype_map[col] == 'float64':
            target_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(target_df[col], errors='coerce').astype('float64')

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
